questions.prompt: Which of these is a purpose statement rather than something belonging in another section?
choices: This project is a Python program
This project uses loops, functions and file handling
Homework due dates get lost across several notebooks, so this keeps them in one list a student can check in a second
This will be the best task manager anyone has written
questions.explain: A purpose names a problem and who has it. Naming the Python features says how you will build it, which is what technical requirements are for.

questions.prompt: Match each proposal section to what belongs in it.
right: The csv module, for reading and writing the saved list
A task name typed in, a numbered list printed out
Due dates get lost across several notebooks
questions.explain: Each section answers a different question: why, with what, what flows through it, and for whom. A proposal is only useful later if those stay separate.

questions.prompt: Halfway through building, you find the library you named in the proposal will not do what you need. What is the proposal good for now?
choices: Nothing, it is out of date
It shows which features depended on that choice, so you know what actually changes
It commits you to using that library
It has to be rewritten before you can carry on coding
questions.explain: A proposal is a reference document, not a contract. Its value here is that the dependency was written down before you had to reason about it under pressure.

questions.prompt: Why does listing features in order of importance help more than listing them alphabetically?
choices: Alphabetical lists are harder to read
The order is the build order, so the top of the list is what a half-finished project has
questions.explain: Most projects run out of time before they run out of ideas. Ordering by importance decides in advance which half you keep.

reflection-exercise1.hint: Name the sections and say what each is for. The purpose section is the one that stops the rest drifting.

reflection-exercise2.hint: A purpose that names a real problem, and features specific enough that you could tell when one is done.
